verdict.rationale: The evidence shows RustDesk can be self-hosted so data stays on the customer's own infrastructure (docs-18, docs-20), and Server Pro offers audit logs and session recording. None of it documents retention periods, deletion controls or purge mechanisms for logs, recordings or connection data. Self-hosting is a data-residency control, not retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
